summary: End-to-end testing of ClockWork app: 23/23 backend pytest tests passed across auth, workers, tasks, time entries, payroll, and logout. Frontend UI tested with Playwright: admin login → /admin redirect, worker creation modal, task creation modal (Radix Select assignee), payroll page, dashboard stats, logout, worker login → /worker, clock-in/clock-out timer, role-based redirect (worker→/admin blocked), worker history page — all PASS. Two minor UI concerns: (1) inline admin task action testids (complete/delete) using pattern `task-complete-{id}`/`task-delete-{id}` were NOT found in DOM on Tasks page after creating a task, so the 'admin marks task complete from Tasks page' and 'admin delete task' UI flows could not be verified via testids (backend PATCH/DELETE endpoints work). (2) Inline price edit field exists (`task-price-{id}`) but blur/Tab did not visibly commit the new price in the rendered list during one quick check — possibly needs a save trigger or refetch. Both are minor.

ui_bugs.issue: Inline 'mark complete' and 'delete' buttons appear missing or lack expected data-testid (no `task-complete-<id>` or `task-delete-<id>` found in DOM after task creation). Backend endpoints PATCH /api/tasks/{id} and DELETE /api/tasks/{id} both work via pytest. Please verify these buttons exist with data-testid for testability.
Editing `task-price-<id>` and blurring did not visibly update the price text in the list; main agent should confirm save trigger (onBlur/Enter) and refetch logic. Backend PATCH with price works.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning logged in console)

action_items: Verify AdminTasks.jsx renders 'mark complete' and 'delete' buttons per task row with data-testid `task-complete-<id>` and `task-delete-<id>` (or document the actual ones).
Confirm inline price edit commits via onBlur (or Enter) and refreshes the list — currently could not verify visually.
Add aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent components (worker / task dialogs) to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `set_auth_cookies` uses samesite=none + secure=true which is correct for cross-site preview deployment; ensure HTTPS is always used (it is).

server.py logout: requires auth (Depends(get_current_user)) — if access token already expired, client cannot logout cleanly. Consider making logout tolerate expired/missing token and just clear cookies.
server.py seed_admin updates password when env password changes — good. Bcrypt $2b$ format verified.
Task PATCH for workers requires status to be in ('in_progress','completed','assigned') — correctly rejects price changes by workers (returns 400 'Workers may only update status').
AuthContext stores access_token in localStorage in addition to httpOnly cookies — fine for cross-site fallback but be aware of XSS exposure.
All endpoints under /api prefix; CORS restricted to FRONTEND_URL with credentials — good.
Mongo `_id` consistently excluded in projections — good.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core flows pass; 2 minor inline-action concerns on AdminTasks)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@clockwork.com / admin123 (verified). Workers created dynamically per test run (e.g., uitest3_<ts>@clockwork.com / worker123).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 UI test workers (uitest_*, uitest2_*, uitest3_*@clockwork.com) and several test tasks during runs. Backend test cleanup deletes its own worker via DELETE /api/workers/{id} (cascades tasks/time entries).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is 100% green. Admin Tasks page inline action testids should be verified — the create/edit flow works but the per-row complete/delete buttons did not surface testids matching `task-complete-<id>`/`task-delete-<id>` in DOM scans. Use Playwright to inspect actual data-testid names rendered on a created task row. All other flows confirmed working including clock-in/out (live timer transitions clock-in-btn → clock-out-btn), worker→/admin role guard redirect, and httpOnly cookie + Bearer token auth fallback.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no blocking issues. Two minor frontend testability concerns documented above.
